svg.title: Write the kill criteria before you write the code
svg.desc: A bar chart whose two measured bars are judged against a pre-committed dashed kill-line: the short bar stays under it and passes, the tall bar crosses it and is struck out with an X. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Write the kill criteria before you write the code”. A organic lattice probed by 4 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 2133998845.
